role: A no-lookahead half-month oil strategy driven by appointed strategy-research, company-risk and execution-desk profiles, with pre-trade company approval, continuous execution-quality mapping, penetration-based weekly fills, neutral-score-50 TCA, exact cost attribution, and fully reconciled net PnL.
invariants: strategy decisions read only the visible market, published forecast, account state, appointed strategy and execution profiles, optional development-only turnover override, and trailing fee state
company risk approval runs after strategy intent and before execution; it can preserve or shrink each target but can never enlarge it or reverse its sign
company risk uses only visible volatility, current and peak equity, current positions, public limits, and the appointed company risk profile
the all-50 company risk profile preserves targets already valid under the previous strategy bounds when drawdown controls are inactive
reduce-only company state never increases absolute exposure and risk-scale recovery is capped per half-month
configured research-institution capability scores never enter strategy style, signal, position sizing, fill, or execution-cost formulas
the player-facing service chooses appointed generated personnel and never accepts free-form strategy radar values
execution capability and style are continuous from 0 through 100 and an all-50 profile exactly reproduces neutral execution parameters
execution ability never changes forecast signals or ideal target-position intent
market contract margin rates, position limits, execution capacity, hard exchange and clearing fees, cash settlement fees, spreads and base slippage remain external owners
holding patience can retain an existing same-direction target but can never expand it beyond the resolved risk capacity
weekly allocation weights, expected net edge, budget utilization, cost estimates, and fee tier are frozen at the decision cutoff
realized weekly OHLC and volume enter only settlement-time fill penetration, spread, slippage, and PnL attribution
a limit touch alone does not guarantee a full fill; fill ratio grows only with realized penetration beyond the frozen limit
net adjustment and round trips share one published gross execution capacity
net-adjustment and round-trip cost attribution sums exactly to each weekly execution total
buy lots minus sell lots equals net position change and buy lots plus sell lots equals gross turnover
spread and slippage costs are charged once as cash attribution and are never deducted again through raw market fill prices
rebates apply only to eligible execution-fee components, use prior rolling volume, and can never make net fees negative
cash settlement is not market turnover and incurs no spread or slippage
TCA compares actual execution with score-50 execution on the same realized orders and excludes hard cash-settlement fees
the strategy never changes public prices, market volume, market open interest, forecasts, or macro rows
